notes.title: Up to 20% off on Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead with the loyalty discount!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5213421/e584f20a8bc22cc9ab4afae414747270bedd92d6.jpg

Dear constructors and engineers,

just a few days to go till the launch of our latest instalment of our Bridge Constructor franchise; Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead! The game’s pre-order also comes at a 10% discount - and by the way; till November 26th there will be an additional special 10% loyalty discount available on the game if you own at least one of the already released Bridge Constructor games.

Means you can save up to 20% on Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead if you own just one of the following games:

 Bridge Constructor
 Bridge Constructor Portal
 Bridge Constructor Stunts
 Bridge Constructor Playground
 Bridge Constructor Medieval

Until then, all the best and stay healthy!
ClockStone & Headup


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1336120
